title: 第一卷 第1章 十八岁外挂到账了第一卷 第2章 我梦见了一个神仙
slug: 斗罗v开局上交系统全宗为我抢亲
lines: “少爷，张嘴。”
天斗城。
七宝琉璃宗后山别院。
红袖声音绵软，指尖剥开一颗冰镇过的紫玉葡萄，剔除果核，送入宁天口中。
宁天则是惬意地闭着眼，后脑勺陷在两团柔软之中。
另一名侍女绿萝捧着一沓厚厚的丝帛请帖，恭敬地站在软榻前。
“少爷，天斗城百花楼的花魁送来请帖，邀您今夜登楼品鉴新曲。”
“城南雪星亲王递了拜帖，说是得了一件新奇的魂导器，想请您过府一叙。”
“还有烈焰男爵的千金……”
宁天闻言，眼皮都没抬一下：
“百花楼的曲子嘛，晚上去听听，烈焰男爵千金的茶话会推了，那女人香粉味太重。
至于雪星亲王家那个……”
他顿了顿，嘴角勾起一抹戏谑：“就说我病了。
病得很重，起不来床。”
绿萝抿嘴偷笑，将那份烫金的拜帖抽出来扔进一旁的废纸篓。
整个七宝琉璃宗，谁不知道自家大少爷的脾性？
看似纨绔，实则腹黑。
宁天说完，换了个舒服的姿势，继续躺着。
作为穿越者，宁天刚来到这个世界时，也曾踌躇满志。
投胎成七宝琉璃宗宗主宁风致的长子，这是绝对的天胡开局。
天下第一富有的宗门，父亲是上三宗宗主，宗门内还有剑斗罗、骨斗罗两位超级斗罗当靠山。
他原本的计划很宏大：截胡绝世机缘，镇压武魂殿，脚踢两大帝国，顺便再和美女游山玩水，大被同眠。
然而，现实却给了他一记干脆利落的耳光。
六岁那年，武魂觉醒仪式上，别人觉醒七宝琉璃塔，光芒璀璨。
他觉醒的，是一座孤零零、只有一层的琉璃塔。
没错，就是七宝琉璃宗里史无前例的变异武魂，一宝琉璃塔。
先天魂力，更是只有半级！
不死心的宁风致耗费无数天材地宝，硬生生砸资源让他修炼。
十二年过去，宁天十八岁了，魂力永远卡在九级。
无法获取第一个魂环，更无法突破到十级。
只能说，绝对的废柴，毫无武魂修炼天赋。
换做别的穿越者，这时候恐怕已经离家出走去寻找奇遇了。
但宁天没有。
他也不是没有盘算过，带着剑斗罗和骨斗罗去落日森林的冰火两仪眼，弄几株仙草。
毕竟只要吞下绮罗郁金香，武魂大概率能产生良性进化，成为九宝琉璃塔。
但思来想去，他又觉得这毫无意义。
就算他运气逆天，一宝琉璃塔进化成了九宝琉璃塔，结局依旧是个死胡同。
content_en:
"Master, open your mouth."
Tiandou City.
Qibao Glazed Sect's Back Mountain Villa.
Hong Xiu's voice was soft, and she peeled a chilled purple jade grape open with her fingertips, removed the core, and put it into Ning Tian's mouth.
Ning Tian closed his eyes comfortably, and the back of his head sank into two soft masses.
Another maid, Lu Luo, held a stack of thick silk invitations and stood respectfully in front of the soft couch.
"Master, the oiran from Baihua Tower in Tiandou City has sent an invitation, inviting you to go up to the building tonight to taste the new song."
"Prince Xuexing from the south of the city handed over a greeting card. He said that he had obtained a novel soul tool and would like to invite you to visit him."
"And the daughter of the Flame Baron..."
When Ning Tian heard this, he didn't even raise his eyelids:
"The music of Baihualou, let's go and listen to it in the evening. I rejected it for the tea party held by Baron Flame's daughter. The smell of women's perfume is too strong.
As for the one from Prince Xuexing’s house…”
He paused, and a hint of joking appeared at the corner of his mouth: "Just say I'm sick.
Very sick and couldn't get out of bed. "
"Yes."
Lulu pursed her lips and snickered, took out the gold-gilded invitation and threw it into the wastebasket aside.
Who in the entire Qibao Glazed Sect doesn't know the temperament of their eldest young master?
He looks like a playboy, but he is actually a sinister person.
After Ning Tian finished speaking, he changed into a comfortable position and continued to lie down.
As a time traveler, Ning Tian was also very ambitious when he first came to this world.
Reborn as the eldest son of Ning Fengzhi, the leader of the Qibao Glazed Sect, this is an absolute start for Tianhu.
The richest sect in the world, his father is the head of the three previous sects, and the sect also has two super Douluo, Sword Douluo and Bone Douluo, as backers.
His original plan was grand: to cut off Hu's unique opportunity, suppress the Wuhun Palace, defeat the two great empires, and at the same time travel with the beautiful woman and sleep with him.
However, reality gave him a slap in the face.
When he was six years old, during the Wuhun Awakening Ceremony, someone else awakened the Seven Treasures Glazed Pagoda, shining brightly.
What he awakened was a lonely glazed tower with only one floor.
That's right, it's the Yibao Glazed Pagoda, the unprecedented mutated martial spirit in the Qibao Glazed Sect.
The innate soul power is only half a level!
Ning Fengzhi, who was unwilling to give up, spent countless resources from heaven and earth to force him to practice.
Twelve years have passed, Ning Tian is eighteen years old, and his soul power is always stuck at level nine.
It is impossible to obtain the first soul ring, let alone break through to level ten.
It can only be said that he is an absolute loser and has no talent for martial arts cultivation.
If it were any other time traveler, I would have already run away from home to look for adventure.
But Ning Tian didn't.
It wasn't like he hadn't planned to take Sword Douluo and Bone Douluo to the Ice and Fire Eyes in Sunset Forest to get some fairy grass.
After all, as long as the Qiluo Tulip is swallowed, the martial soul will most likely evolve benignly and become the Nine Treasure Glazed Tile Pagoda.
But after thinking about it, he felt that it was meaningless.
Even if he was unlucky and the One Treasure Glazed Tile Tower evolved into the Nine Treasure Glazed Tile Tower, the ending would still be a dead end.
